paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֨סֶף ע֥וֹד דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־כָּל־בָּח֥וּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃

i18n.en: And David again gathered all the chosen men of Yisra'el, thirty thousand.

notes.official: *wayyōsep̄ ʿôḏ dāwiḏ ʾeṯ-kol-bāḥûr bəyiśrāʾēl* 'And David again gathered all the chosen men of Yisra'el'. The MT points the verb as from *yāsap̄* 'add, do again', but with a direct object the sense 'gathered' (*ʾāsap̄*, with the aleph elided; LXX *synēgagen*) is required, and *ʿôḏ* supplies 'again'. The line keeps the ASV (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`; overlay `lexical-cruxes-2-samuel-6`). 'David' is kept in English; 'Yisra'el' = Israel (`hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`). 2 Samuel 6 continues the ark narrative of 1 Sam 4-6, after the ark's twenty years at Qiryat-Ye'arim (1 Sam 7:1-2).

paragraphs.text: וַיָּ֣קָם ׀ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וְכָל־הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ מִֽבַּעֲלֵ֖י יְהוּדָ֑ה לְהַעֲל֣וֹת מִשָּׁ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֣א שֵׁ֗ם שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יֹשֵׁ֥ב הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עָלָֽיו׃

i18n.en: And David arose and went, with all the people who were with him, from Ba'alei-Yehudah, to bring up from there the ark of the Elohim, which is called by the name, the name of YHWH of hosts, who is enthroned on the cherubim.

notes.official:
*mibbaʿălê yəhûḏâ* 'from Ba'alei-Yehudah' = Baale-judah (ASV): the place is Qiryat-Ye'arim (Josh 15:9; 1 Chr 13:6 'to Ba'alah, that is, to Qiryat-Ye'arim'). The expected 'to' is missing: the MT has David set out *from* the town he is going to, and 4QSamᵃ and Chronicles read 'to Ba'alah, which is Qiryat-Ye'arim'. The line translates the MT (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`; McCarter, *II Samuel*, AB 9, 1984).

*ʾăšer-niqrāʾ šēm šēm YHWH ṣəḇāʾôṯ yōšēḇ hakkəruḇîm ʿālāyw* 'which is called by the name, the name of YHWH of hosts, who is enthroned on the cherubim' (overlay `yoshev-hakkeruvim-enthroned-on-the-cherubim-2-samuel-6-2`; `yhwh-tsevaot-yhwh-of-hosts-former-prophets`; central `cherubim-ezek`). The doubled *šēm* may be a dittography (the LXX and 1 Chr 13:6 have it once), and the line keeps both. *ʿālāyw* 'over it' resumes the relative *ʾăšer*: the name is 'called over' the ark, the idiom of ownership (Deut 28:10; Jer 7:10-11). *yōšēḇ hakkəruḇîm* is a fixed divine title (1 Sam 4:4; 2 Kgs 19:15; Ps 80:2; 99:1). It presents the cherubim of the ark as YHWH's throne (central `aron-ark-of-the-covenant-ark-of-the-elohim-cross-corpus`), so the line has 'enthroned' (NRSV, NJPS) for the ASV's 'that sitteth [above]'. *ʾărôn hāʾĕlōhîm* 'the ark of the Elohim', with the Hebrew article (`elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`, clause 1).

paragraphs.text: וַיַּרְכִּ֜בוּ אֶת־אֲר֤וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־עֲגָלָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֔הוּ מִבֵּ֥ית אֲבִינָדָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּגִּבְעָ֑ה וְעֻזָּ֣א וְאַחְי֗וֹ בְּנֵי֙ אֲבִ֣ינָדָ֔ב נֹהֲגִ֖ים אֶת־הָעֲגָלָ֥ה חֲדָשָֽׁה׃

i18n.en: And they set the ark of the Elohim on a new cart, and carried it from the house of Avinadav, which was on the hill; and Uzzah and Achyo, the sons of Avinadav, were driving the new cart.

notes.official: *wayyarkibû ʾeṯ-ʾărôn hāʾĕlōhîm ʾel-ʿăḡālâ ḥăḏāšâ* 'And they set the ark of the Elohim on a new cart', as the Pelishtim had done (1 Sam 6:7). The Torah prescribes that the Levites carry the ark on poles (Num 4:15; 7:9), and 1 Chr 15:13-15 explains the death of Uzzah by this breach. 'Avinadav' = Abinadab; 'Uzzah' = Uzzah: the MT writes the name *ʿuzzāʾ* here and in v 6 and *ʿuzzâ* in vv 7-8, and the line normalises it to one form. 'Achyo' = Ahio (`hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`). *baggiḇʿâ* 'on the hill' (ASV 'in the hill'), probably the hill of 1 Sam 7:1, though it may be the place-name Giv'ah.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֗הוּ מִבֵּ֤ית אֲבִֽינָדָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּגִּבְעָ֔ה עִ֖ם אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאַחְי֕וֹ הֹלֵ֖ךְ לִפְנֵ֥י הָאָרֽוֹן׃

i18n.en: And they carried it from the house of Avinadav, which was on the hill, with the ark of the Elohim; and Achyo was walking before the ark.

notes.official: The verse opens by repeating the end of v 3 (*wayyiśśāʾuhû mibbêṯ ʾăḇînāḏāḇ ʾăšer baggiḇʿâ*). The repetition is usually taken as a dittography, and the LXX and 4QSamᵃ have a shorter text. The line translates the MT as it stands (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`; McCarter, AB 9). *wəʾaḥyô* 'and Achyo' may also be read *wəʾeḥāyw* 'and his brothers' (LXX *hoi adelphoi autou*), which would leave Uzzah as the only named driver. The MT name is kept.

paragraphs.text: וְדָוִ֣ד ׀ וְכָל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מְשַֽׂחֲקִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים וּבְכִנֹּר֤וֹת וּבִנְבָלִים֙ וּבְתֻפִּ֔ים וּבִמְנַֽעַנְעִ֖ים וּֽבְצֶלְצֶלִֽים׃

i18n.en: And David and all the house of Yisra'el were playing before YHWH with all kinds of instruments of fir-wood, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with castanets, and with cymbals.

notes.official: *məśaḥăqîm lip̄nê YHWH* 'were playing before YHWH': *śiḥēq* is 'make merry, play', used of music and dance (1 Sam 18:7), and David repeats it in v 21 ('I will play before YHWH'). *bəḵōl ʿăṣê ḇərôšîm* 'with all kinds of instruments of fir-wood': the MT 'with all woods of cypress' is widely regarded as a corruption of *bəḵol-ʿōz ûḇəšîrîm* 'with all their might and with songs', the reading of 1 Chr 13:8, 4QSamᵃ and the LXX. The line translates the MT with the ASV's 'instruments' (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`; overlay `lexical-cruxes-2-samuel-6`). The instruments keep the ASV names: *kinnōrôṯ* 'harps' (modern versions 'lyres'), *nəḇālîm* 'psalteries' (a larger stringed instrument, NRSV 'harps'), *tuppîm* 'timbrels' (hand-drums), *mənaʿanʿîm* 'castanets' (probably sistrums, rattles that are shaken), *ṣelṣəlîm* 'cymbals'. psalms-woh 33:2 uses the same 'harp' and 'psaltery'.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־גֹּ֣רֶן נָכ֑וֹן וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח עֻזָּ֜א אֶל־אֲר֤וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ וַיֹּ֣אחֶז בּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י שָׁמְט֖וּ הַבָּקָֽר׃

i18n.en: And when they came to the threshing floor of Nakhon, Uzzah reached out to the ark of the Elohim and took hold of it, for the oxen stumbled.

notes.official:
*wayyāḇōʾû ʿaḏ-gōren nāḵôn* 'And when they came to the threshing floor of Nakhon' = Nacon (ASV); 1 Chr 13:9 has 'Kidon'. *wayyišlaḥ ʿuzzāʾ ʾel-ʾărôn hāʾĕlōhîm* 'Uzzah reached out to the ark of the Elohim': the verb has no object in the MT. The ASV supplies '[his hand]' and 1 Chr 13:9 has *ʾeṯ-yāḏô*; 'reached out' renders the verb without supplying the noun (overlay `lexical-cruxes-2-samuel-6`). *kî šāməṭû habbāqār* 'for the oxen stumbled': *šāmaṭ* is 'let drop, release' (BDB), so the oxen either stumbled (ASV, NJPS) or let the cart tilt (NRSV 'shook it'). The ASV is kept.

**Wheel of Heaven reading (reception note, not a translation claim).** *The Book Which Tells the Truth* (ch. 3) quotes vv 6-7 ('Uzzah put forth (his hand) to the ark of God, and took hold of it, for the oxen shook it. And the anger of Yahweh was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error: and there he died by the ark of God') and comments: 'The ark had nearly tipped over and Uzzah, trying to hold it back, had touched a dangerous part of the apparatus. He had been electrocuted.' The book reads the ark as housing a transmitter-receiver with its own power source. The canon's English supplies '(his hand)' as the ASV does and has 'shook it' for *šāməṭû*. The line renders the verbs without supplement and does not encode that reading.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּעֻזָּ֔ה וַיַּכֵּ֥הוּ שָׁ֛ם הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל־הַשַּׁ֑ל וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

i18n.en: And the anger of YHWH was kindled against Uzzah, and the Elohim struck him there for his error; and he died there beside the ark of the Elohim.

notes.official: *wayyiḥar-ʾap̄ YHWH bəʿuzzâ* 'And the anger of YHWH was kindled against Uzzah'. *wayyakkēhû šām hāʾĕlōhîm ʿal-haššal* 'and the Elohim struck him there for his error': *hāʾĕlōhîm* has the article and is the narrative subject (`elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`, clause 1). *šal* occurs only here and is usually explained as 'error, negligence' (ASV 'error'; NRSV 'because he reached out his hand to the ark', following 1 Chr 13:10; 4QSamᵃ has a different reading). The ASV is kept (overlay `lexical-cruxes-2-samuel-6`; `mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`). *wayyāmāṯ šām ʿim ʾărôn hāʾĕlōhîm* 'and he died there beside the ark of the Elohim'. Num 4:15 forbids even the Qehatite bearers to touch the holy objects, on pain of death. See the reception note at v 6.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּ֣חַר לְדָוִ֔ד עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּרַ֧ץ יְהוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּעֻזָּ֑ה וַיִּקְרָ֞א לַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ פֶּ֣רֶץ עֻזָּ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

i18n.en: And David was displeased, because YHWH had broken out with a breach against Uzzah; and he called that place Peretz-Uzzah, to this day.

notes.official: *wayyiḥar lədāwiḏ* 'And David was displeased' (ASV; NRSV 'angry'; NJPS 'distressed'): the same verb *ḥārâ* 'burn' as YHWH's anger in v 7, so David's anger answers YHWH's (overlay `lexical-cruxes-2-samuel-6`). *ʿal ʾăšer pāraṣ YHWH pereṣ bəʿuzzâ* 'because YHWH had broken out with a breach against Uzzah'. *wayyiqrāʾ lammāqôm hahûʾ pereṣ ʿuzzâ ʿaḏ hayyôm hazzeh* 'and he called that place Peretz-Uzzah, to this day' = Perez-uzzah (central `al-ken-qara-shemah-aetiological-naming-formula-cross-corpus`; `ad-ha-yom-ha-zeh-aetiological-formula`). The name is transliterated so that the play *pāraṣ ... pereṣ ... Pereṣ* stays visible, as at Gen 38:29 (central `peretz-breach-davidic-ancestor-etymology`), and it is not glossed in parentheses, since the Former Prophets have no gloss rule (cf. Gilgal, Josh 5:9). The verb *pāraṣ* recurs at 5:20, Ba'al-Peratzim, where YHWH breaks out against David's enemies.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּרָ֥א דָוִ֛ד אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵ֛יךְ יָב֥וֹא אֵלַ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And David was afraid of YHWH that day, and he said, "How shall the ark of YHWH come to me?"

notes.official: *ʾêḵ yāḇôʾ ʾēlay ʾărôn YHWH* 'How shall the ark of YHWH come to me?': the fear of the ark after Peretz-Uzzah repeats the question of the men of Beit-Shemesh (1 Sam 6:20).

paragraphs.text: וְלֹֽא־אָבָ֣ה דָוִ֗ד לְהָסִ֥יר אֵלָ֛יו אֶת־אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָ֖ה עַל־עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיַּטֵּ֣הוּ דָוִ֔ד בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־אֱד֖וֹם הַגִּתִּֽי׃

i18n.en: So David was not willing to move the ark of YHWH to himself into the city of David; but David turned it aside to the house of Oved-Edom the Gittite.

notes.official: *ʿōḇēḏ-ʾĕḏōm haggittî* 'Oved-Edom the Gittite' = Obed-edom: 'Gittite' is the '-ite' gentilic of Gat (Gath) (`hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`). A man of Gath may be a Pelishti in David's service, like Ittai (15:19), and Chronicles makes Oved-Edom a Levite gatekeeper (1 Chr 15:18, 24; 26:4). *ʿal-ʿîr dāwiḏ* 'into the city of David'.

paragraphs.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב֩ אֲר֨וֹן יְהוָ֜ה בֵּ֣ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם הַגִּתִּ֖י שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־כָּל־בֵּיתֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: And the ark of YHWH remained in the house of Oved-Edom the Gittite three months; and YHWH blessed Oved-Edom and all his household.

notes.official: *wayḇāreḵ YHWH ʾeṯ-ʿōḇēḏ ʾĕḏōm wəʾeṯ-kol-bêṯô* 'and YHWH blessed Oved-Edom and all his household': the ark that killed Uzzah brings blessing to the house that receives it.

paragraphs.text: וַיֻּגַּ֗ד לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִד֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בֵּרַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֤ד אֱדֹם֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וַיַּעַל֩ אֶת־אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים מִבֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם עִ֥יר דָּוִ֖ד בְּשִׂמְחָֽה׃

i18n.en: And it was told King David, saying, "YHWH has blessed the house of Oved-Edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of the Elohim." And David went and brought up the ark of the Elohim from the house of Oved-Edom into the city of David with rejoicing.

notes.official: *baʿăḇûr ʾărôn hāʾĕlōhîm* 'because of the ark of the Elohim' (`elohim-referent-and-article-conventions-former-prophets`, clause 1). *bəśimḥâ* 'with rejoicing'.

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֗י כִּ֧י צָעֲד֛וּ נֹשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרוֹן־יְהוָ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֣ה צְעָדִ֑ים וַיִּזְבַּ֥ח שׁ֖וֹר וּמְרִֽיא׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass, when those who carried the ark of YHWH had gone six paces, that he sacrificed an ox and a fatling.

notes.official: *kî ṣāʿăḏû nōśəʾê ʾărôn-YHWH šiššâ ṣəʿāḏîm* 'when those who carried the ark of YHWH had gone six paces': the ark is now carried, not driven (cf. v 3). *wayyizbaḥ šôr ûmərîʾ* 'that he sacrificed an ox and a fatling' (central `qorbanot-sacrificial-offering-vocabulary-cluster-cross-corpus`). The text may mean a single sacrifice after the first six steps or a sacrifice every six steps, as later tradition took it.

paragraphs.text: וְדָוִ֛ד מְכַרְכֵּ֥ר בְּכָל־עֹ֖ז לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְדָוִ֕ד חָג֖וּר אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד׃

i18n.en: And David danced before YHWH with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

notes.official: *wədāwiḏ məḵarkēr bəḵol-ʿōz lip̄nê YHWH* 'And David danced before YHWH with all his might': *kirkēr* (only here and v 16) is a whirling dance. *ʾēp̄ôḏ bāḏ* 'a linen ephod', the short linen garment of priests and attendants at the sanctuary (1 Sam 2:18; 22:18), distinct from the high priest's ephod of Ex 28 (overlay `lexical-cruxes-2-samuel-6`).

paragraphs.text: וְדָוִד֙ וְכָל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַעֲלִ֖ים אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה בִּתְרוּעָ֖ה וּבְק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃

i18n.en: So David and all the house of Yisra'el brought up the ark of YHWH with shouting and with the sound of the shofar.

notes.official: *bitrûʿâ ûḇəqôl šôp̄ār* 'with shouting and with the sound of the shofar': *tərûʿâ* is the people's shout, as in Josh 6, and *šôp̄ār* follows central `shofar-rams-horn-signal-instrument-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: וְהָיָה֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה בָּ֖א עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וּמִיכַ֨ל בַּת־שָׁא֜וּל נִשְׁקְפָ֣ה ׀ בְּעַ֣ד הַחַלּ֗וֹן וַתֵּ֨רֶא אֶת־הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ מְפַזֵּ֤ז וּמְכַרְכֵּר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתִּ֥בֶז ל֖וֹ בְּלִבָּֽהּ׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass, as the ark of YHWH came into the city of David, that Mikhal the daughter of Sha'ul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before YHWH; and she despised him in her heart.

notes.official: 'Mikhal' = Michal; 'Sha'ul' = Saul (`hebrew-proper-name-transliteration-convention-former-prophets`). *nišqəp̄â bəʿaḏ haḥallôn* 'looked out through the window': the motif of the woman at the window (Judg 5:28; 2 Kgs 9:30). *məp̄azzēz ûməḵarkēr* 'leaping and dancing'. *wattiḇez lô bəlibbāh* 'and she despised him in her heart'. The scene of vv 20-23 is prepared here.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּבִ֜אוּ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֗ה וַיַּצִּ֤גוּ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּמְקוֹמ֔וֹ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָטָה־ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑ד וַיַּ֨עַל דָּוִ֥ד עֹל֛וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וּשְׁלָמִֽים׃

i18n.en: And they brought in the ark of YHWH and set it in its place, inside the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt-offerings before YHWH, and peace-offerings.

notes.official: *bətôḵ hāʾōhel ʾăšer nāṭâ-lô dāwiḏ* 'inside the tent that David had pitched for it': the ark is housed in a tent, not a temple, which 7:2-7 discusses. *ʿōlôṯ ... ûšəlāmîm* 'burnt-offerings ... and peace-offerings' (central `olah-burnt-offering`, `qorbanot-sacrificial-offering-vocabulary-cluster-cross-corpus`).

paragraphs.text: וַיְכַ֣ל דָּוִ֔ד מֵהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעוֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם בְּשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

i18n.en: And when David had finished offering the burnt-offering and the peace-offerings, he blessed the people in the name of YHWH of hosts.

notes.official: *wayḇāreḵ ʾeṯ-hāʿām bəšēm YHWH ṣəḇāʾôṯ* 'he blessed the people in the name of YHWH of hosts' (`yhwh-tsevaot-yhwh-of-hosts-former-prophets`). The king blesses the people, as Shelomoh does at the temple's dedication (1 Kgs 8:14, 55).

paragraphs.text: וַיְחַלֵּ֨ק לְכָל־הָעָ֜ם לְכָל־הֲמ֣וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְמֵאִ֣ישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה֒ לְאִ֗ישׁ חַלַּ֥ת לֶ֙חֶם֙ אַחַ֔ת וְאֶשְׁפָּ֣ר אֶחָ֔ד וַאֲשִׁישָׁ֖ה אֶחָ֑ת וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: And he distributed to all the people, to the whole multitude of Yisra'el, both men and women, to each one a cake of bread, and a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins. So all the people went away, each to his house.

notes.official: *ḥallaṯ leḥem ʾaḥaṯ wəʾešpār ʾeḥāḏ waʾăšîšâ ʾeḥāṯ* 'a cake of bread, and a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins'. *ʾešpār* occurs only here and in the parallel 1 Chr 16:3. It is variously explained as a portion of meat (Vulgate *assaturam bubulae carnis* 'a piece of roast beef'; ASV 'a portion [of flesh]'), a cake baked in a pan (NJPS) or a date-cake; the line keeps the ASV sense without brackets (overlay `lexical-cruxes-2-samuel-6`). *ʾăšîšâ* 'a cake of raisins' (Hos 3:1; Song 2:5).

paragraphs.text: וַיָּ֥שָׁב דָּוִ֖ד לְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶת־בֵּית֑וֹ וַתֵּצֵ֞א מִיכַ֤ל בַּת־שָׁאוּל֙ לִקְרַ֣את דָּוִ֔ד וַתֹּ֗אמֶר מַה־נִּכְבַּ֨ד הַיּ֜וֹם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִגְלָ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ לְעֵינֵ֨י אַמְה֣וֹת עֲבָדָ֔יו כְּהִגָּל֥וֹת נִגְל֖וֹת אַחַ֥ד הָרֵקִֽים׃

i18n.en: Then David returned to bless his household. And Mikhal the daughter of Sha'ul came out to meet David and said, "How glorious the king of Yisra'el was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of the maidservants of his servants, as one of the worthless fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!"

notes.official: *mah-niḵbaḏ hayyôm meleḵ yiśrāʾēl* 'How glorious the king of Yisra'el was today': Mikhal's sarcasm plays on *kāḇēḏ* 'be honoured' (v 22 *ʾikkāḇēḏâ*). *ʾăšer niḡlâ hayyôm ... kəhiggālôṯ niḡlôṯ ʾaḥaḏ hārēqîm* 'who uncovered himself today ... as one of the worthless fellows shamelessly uncovers himself': the infinitive construction intensifies the verb, and the short ephod of v 14 exposed the dancer.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִד֮ אֶל־מִיכַל֒ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּֽחַר־בִּ֤י מֵֽאָבִיךְ֙ וּמִכָּל־בֵּית֔וֹ לְצַוֺּ֨ת אֹתִ֥י נָגִ֛יד עַל־עַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשִׂחַקְתִּ֖י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And David said to Mikhal, "It was before YHWH, who chose me above your father and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of YHWH, over Yisra'el; and I will play before YHWH.

notes.official: *lip̄nê YHWH ʾăšer bāḥar-bî mēʾāḇîḵ* 'It was before YHWH, who chose me above your father': David's answer turns Mikhal's father, Sha'ul, into the rejected king. *nāḡîḏ* 'prince' (ASV), the designation of the chosen ruler (1 Sam 9:16; 13:14; 25:30), as 1 Kgs 1:35 prints it (NRSV 'prince'). *wəśiḥaqtî lip̄nê YHWH* 'and I will play before YHWH', the verb of v 5 (overlay `lexical-cruxes-2-samuel-6`).

paragraphs.text: וּנְקַלֹּ֤תִי עוֹד֙ מִזֹּ֔את וְהָיִ֥יתִי שָׁפָ֖ל בְּעֵינָ֑י וְעִם־הָֽאֲמָהוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתְּ עִמָּ֖ם אִכָּבֵֽדָה׃

i18n.en: And I will make myself yet more contemptible than this, and I will be lowly in my own eyes; but with the maidservants of whom you have spoken, with them I shall be held in honor."

notes.official: *ûnəqallōṯî ʿôḏ mizzōʾṯ* 'And I will make myself yet more contemptible than this': *qālal* 'be light, of no account' is the opposite of *kāḇēḏ* 'be heavy, honoured' in v 20. *wəhāyîṯî šāp̄āl bəʿênāy* 'and I will be lowly in my own eyes': the LXX reads 'in your eyes', which fits the contrast with Mikhal's view of him. The line keeps the MT (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`). *ʿim-hāʾămāhôṯ ... ʿimmām ʾikkāḇēḏâ* 'with the maidservants ... with them I shall be held in honor'.

paragraphs.text: וּלְמִיכַל֙ בַּת־שָׁא֔וּל לֹֽא־הָ֥יָה לָ֖הּ יָ֑לֶד עַ֖ד י֥וֹם מוֹתָֽהּ׃ (פ)

i18n.en: And Mikhal the daughter of Sha'ul had no child to the day of her death.

notes.official: *ûləmîḵal baṯ-šāʾûl lōʾ-hāyâ lāh yāleḏ ʿaḏ yôm môṯāh* 'And Mikhal the daughter of Sha'ul had no child to the day of her death': the narrator does not say whether the childlessness is a punishment or the result of David's estrangement. The consequence is that no descendant of Sha'ul will sit on David's throne.
